title: phaeomeria ciliata
intro: Phaeomeria ciliata, commonly known as the Red Salvia or Coral Sage, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including its ability to treat digestive issues and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Phaeomeria ciliata include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe wounds, reduce fever, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and iridoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects and potential health benefits.
